title: Dog & cat breeds
blurb: Tell a Shiba from a Corgi and a Ragdoll from a British Shorthair.

groups.name: Small dogs
groups.intro: The breeds you see most in Hong Kong flats and parks.
groups.hk: Small breeds rule in Hong Kong flats; many housing estates restrict or ban dogs.

items.name: Shiba Inu
items.what: Fox-like Japanese dog with a curled tail; the face of the 'Doge' meme.

items.name: Pomeranian
items.what: Tiny fluffball with a fox face.

items.name: French Bulldog
items.what: Bat-eared, flat-faced and stocky; one of the world's most popular breeds.

items.name: Corgi
items.what: Short legs, big ears, fox face; Queen Elizabeth II's favourite.

items.name: Chihuahua
items.what: The smallest breed, with big ears and a big attitude.

items.name: Dachshund
items.what: Long body and short legs: the 'sausage dog'.

items.name: Toy Poodle
items.what: Curly coat, very smart; toy, miniature and standard sizes.

items.name: Shih Tzu
items.what: Long silky coat, often in a topknot; bred for Chinese palaces.

items.name: Maltese
items.what: Small white dog with a long, silky coat.

items.name: Yorkshire Terrier
items.what: Tiny terrier with a steel-blue and tan silky coat.

items.name: Pug
items.what: Wrinkly flat face, curly tail.

items.name: Bichon Frisé
items.what: White powder-puff coat, trimmed round.

groups.name: Medium & large dogs
groups.intro: Family favourites, working dogs and Instagram stars.

items.name: Golden Retriever
items.what: Golden coat, friendly face; the classic family dog.

items.name: Labrador Retriever
items.what: Short coat in black, yellow or chocolate; the most popular guide dog.

items.name: German Shepherd
items.what: Black-and-tan working dog used by police.

items.name: Siberian Husky
items.what: Wolf-like sled dog with striking blue or odd-coloured eyes.

items.name: Border Collie
items.what: Black-and-white sheepdog, often called the smartest breed.

items.name: Samoyed
items.what: Fluffy white dog with a permanent 'Sammy smile'.

items.name: Akita
items.what: Powerful Japanese dog; Hachikō, the loyal dog of Shibuya Station, was one.

items.name: Bernese Mountain Dog
items.what: Big tricolour Swiss farm dog.

items.name: Shar Pei
items.what: Deep wrinkles and a blue-black tongue; from southern China.

items.name: Chow Chow
items.what: Lion-like mane and a blue-black tongue.

items.name: Beagle
items.what: Floppy-eared scent hound; Snoopy is one.

items.name: Dobermann
items.what: Sleek black-and-rust guard dog.

groups.name: Cats
groups.intro: The breeds cat people talk about.

items.name: British Shorthair
items.what: Round face, dense blue-grey plush coat; the Cheshire Cat look.

items.name: Scottish Fold
items.what: Ears folded forward, owl-like face. The fold gene causes joint problems, so breeding it is controversial.

items.name: Ragdoll
items.what: Big blue-eyed cat that goes floppy when picked up.

items.name: Maine Coon
items.what: One of the largest breeds, with ear tufts and a bushy tail.

items.name: Persian
items.what: Flat face and long, luxurious coat.

items.name: Siamese
items.what: Cream body with dark points and blue eyes; very talkative.

items.name: Bengal
items.what: Leopard-spotted coat from wild cat ancestry.

items.name: Sphynx
items.what: Hairless, wrinkly and warm to the touch.

items.name: Russian Blue
items.what: Silvery-blue coat and green eyes.

items.name: Munchkin
items.what: Very short legs from a natural mutation.

items.name: Norwegian Forest Cat
items.what: Big, long-haired cat built for Scandinavian winters.

items.name: Abyssinian
items.what: Slim, ticked golden coat, like a small wild cat.
